grades.answer_evidence: At 2 conservation, choose to upgrade an Action card or activate an additional worker. At 5 and 8, take 5 money or a Bonus token at that space. The first time anyone reaches 10, all players discard one Final Scoring card; if no one reaches 10 before game end, everyone discards one before scoring. Check the end at the end of your own turn or during a break when your Appeal and Conservation counters are in the same scoring area or pass one another. Appeal gained on another player's turn waits for your own turn or a break to trigger the end unless someone else triggers it first. The triggering player finishes their turn and each other player takes one more turn; if triggered during a break, every player takes one more turn. Each Final Scoring card can award at most 4 conservation points. Victory Points equal your Appeal minus the lowest Appeal value in the scoring area containing your Conservation counter. Highest positive total wins; ties go to the player with the most supported projects, then tied players share the win.
